name: Novello
shape: Eurostat LAU, the commune it is named for

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A commune in the Barolo zone in Piedmont. Barolo is a red DOCG wine made from Nebbiolo, often described as one of Italy's greatest wines, and Novello is one of the communes it covers.
